0.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_WYRKRHIT_000_1
0.description: That's some cliff, ain't it? Ye'd never get cargo up an' down that thing without this great bloody mess o' wood an' pulleys.

1.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_WYRKRHIT_000_2
1.description: A collection o' freight companies banded together to come up with the Skylift ye see here. I guess ye could call me the “face” o' the operation.

2.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_WYRKRHIT_000_3
2.description: Not that I wield aught more authority than the next bloke, ye understand─with Limsa bein' a place built on the ways o' pirates, every bleedin' act is decided by a vote.

3.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_WYRKRHIT_000_4
3.description: So my job is settin' up meetin's an' presidin' over the votes. The grease on the wheels, as it were.

4.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_WYRKRHIT_100_4
4.description: Some days, I'd sooner be drivin' one of them wagons, an' gettin' some <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> work done.

5.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_WYRKRHIT_000_5
5.description: This operation was set up after the Calamity cracked the very ground, an' raised a cliff clear across middle La Noscea.

6.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_WYRKRHIT_000_6
6.description: Ye might rely on cargo ships for deliveries along the coast, but the folk living inland still need our wagons to get through.

7.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_WYRKRHIT_000_7
7.description: This scaffoldin' ain't sturdy enough to hold a fully laden wain, so the ideal solution would be to collapse a section o' the cliff an' make us a ramp. 'Course, no bugger has the time or the resources for that sort of undertakin'. For the time bein', we're stuck usin' what we have.

10.name: TEXT_REGSEASKYLIFT_00071_A1_000_2
10.description: What kind of place is this?
